_doc: Tower looks (TowerLook, TowerDress, WorldBuilder): each tower's facade and crown, by its short id (docs/world/towers.md), else its recipe's, laid over the default. Visual only, so ours throughout; the lore it leans on is noted in _why. The band's own outer walls wear the same look as the impostor facade under it (owner, V1 verdicts: one building, no seam at the band's lowest storey). Colours sit on the night palette (greybox PALETTE). Keys: glass / spandrel / mullion / slab / pier: facade colours (spandrel is the solid wall and the bands between window rows); band_glass: the band's see-through glass tint; mullion_step (squares between mullions), mullion_w; bay: squares per lit room on a generic facade; lit: share of rooms lit at night; dark_floors: share of storeys dark; warm / cool: window light colours, warm_share; seam (+ seam_every squares, seam_glow): vertical light strips; ledge (+ ledge_every storeys): glowing spandrel bands; flood: the facade floodlit in its own colour (0 none); mech_every: a louvred plant storey every n; setbacks: [[storeys under the band, grow per side in squares]]; trim: a lit edge on the roof parapet; crown: fins | logo | ring | tiers | mast (a mast and dishes come with every crown); logo / logo_color: the crown sign (5x7 pixel letters); crown_color: fins and ring light; blade / blade_color / blade_edge: a vertical blade sign at a corner; screens: holo-ad panels on the facade, by colour; greebles: cradle, pipes, gantry, hvac, stub; twin + bridges: a twin tower joined by walkways at these storeys; pad: an AV landing pad cantilevered off the facade.

tower_hotel._why: A hotel tower: dark stone and punched windows, warm rooms, most of them lit (owner, towers art round 2: the stone read as a big tan wall on Forward+, darkened).

raven._why: A deliberately forgettable tower (NC2045 p.124-125) dressed up for the job: black glass, thin cyan seams, cool lab light.

maf._why: Thurgood Towers: twin white skyscrapers joined by walkways every 10 floors, about half the floors empty (NC2045 p.123).

continental._why: Continental Brands (NC2045 p.83): a consumer brand's office tower, warm concrete and its name in red on the crown.

ziggurat._why: Ziggurat HQ (NC2045 p.78), the apex of the city's net company: bronze glass stepping out in tiers, every tier's edge lit gold.

haakensen._why: Haakensen Tower (NC2045 p.143), the district's only new skyscraper: green glass and a lit green crown.

libertine._why: New Libertine Tower (NC2045 p.86): a teal tower, the City Manager's offices on top.

segotari._why: Segotari HQ over EXCEL-1's entertainment floors (NC2045 p.206): magenta seams and holo ads down the facade.

n54._why: Network 54 Plaza (NC2045 p.218): a fortress tower crowned by the N54 sign, its faces running the network's feed.

highcourt._why: Highcourt Plaza (NC2045 p.132): an Art Deco hotel whose guests fly in by Aerocab: amber rooms, deco pilasters, a blade sign and an AV pad.

far._why: The far city's towers: a few facade styles (TowerDress._far_city), each tower its own seed, lit share and accent.
